name: Arcade Masjid
tag: Mosque / a broad arcaded prayer hall
summary: Five open prayer-hall arches and one square Maghrebi tower form a broad, grounded mosque.
why: The arcade centers are 34, 44, 54, 64, and 74; paired side openings are numerically mirrored. The larger central doorway sits on x=54. One square minaret grows directly from the left wall, and a continuous attached cornice joins the whole hall.
risk: The narrow side openings simplify at 24 px. The broad hall and single square tower remain readable, while the central opening keeps the clearest emphasis.
